leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Build a FormGroup with email and password FormControls and compose multiple sync validators using Validators.compose()
Write a custom sync password-strength validator function that returns a ValidationErrors object or null
Implement an async validator that debounces API calls to check email availability, returning an Observable of errors
Display inline error messages only when a field is both invalid and touched, avoiding premature error display
Use exhaustMap on the submit button's click stream to fire the login request and ignore duplicate clicks while in flight
Disable the submit button and show a loading indicator while the async validator or submit request is pending
Reset the form and surface server-side errors (e.g., invalid credentials) as form-level errors after a failed login
